    def __init__(self, s):

        self.m=s.model

        self.jids=np.array([self.m.joint(f'robot0_joint{i}').id for i in range(1,8)])

        self.vidx=self.m.jnt_dofadr[self.jids]

        self.sid=self.m.site('gripper0_right_grip_site').id

    def pose(self):
        return self.d.site_xpos[self.sid].copy(),self.d.site_xmat[self.sid].reshape(3,3).copy()
    def obj(self,name):
        return self.d.xpos[self.s.env.obj_body_id[name]].copy()
    def ik(self,p,rot,seed=None):
        dd=self.ikdata

            J=np.vstack((jp[:,self.vidx],jr[:,self.vidx]))
            dq=J.T@np.linalg.solve(J@J.T+np.eye(6)*1e-5,err)
            dq*=min(1.,0.15/max(np.abs(dq)))
